families.name: ADVERSARIAL_METADATA
families.coverage: Terminal escapes, newlines, bidi controls, long provider text and instruction-like descriptions are injected into diagnostic metadata.

families.name: DIRECT_JSON_ENVELOPE
families.coverage: Direct datasource envelopes are serialized as text and machine JSON while hostile metadata remains bounded data.

families.name: BOUNDED_IDENTIFIERS
families.coverage: Unknown-column candidate names exercise quoting, control characters, bidi text, long values, candidate visibility and automatic-edit rejection.

families.name: RENDERER_ONLY_AGENT_FIXTURES
families.coverage: Instruction-like metadata is retained as literal text for later live-agent fixtures; this family does not invoke or qualify an AI agent.

contract.verificationResult: 48/48 frozen cases verified before observation and again after the final replay; no frozen expectation was replaced.

initialObservations.finding: The first focused invocation terminated before publishing a result directory; it is retained as a failed execution attempt, not as an observation.
The first fixture calibration exposed MSTest collection/assertion API mismatches and an invalid range expression before test execution.
Public envelope data retained raw terminal escapes, status-forging newlines or unbounded metadata in the first production pass.
Identifier candidate facts still exposed raw bidi or long values through the untrusted semantic metadata path.
The renderer and identifier matrix passed before the full gate exposed optional-envelope null preservation regressions.
The final frozen matrix passed after the full-gate compatibility repair and the explicit literal-instruction assertion.

repairAttempts.note: The fixture was brought to a compiling, strict MSTest matrix without changing the frozen case contract.
Shared display/JSON safety, datasource envelope isolation, detailed/context rendering bounds, identifier edit guards and semantic candidate fact sanitization repaired the observed sinks.
The matrix passed, then the first full gate exposed a null-versus-empty compatibility regression in optional datasource envelope fields.
Optional provider text now preserves null, the strengthened literal-instruction assertion passes, and the final matrix is green against the final Release binaries.

focusedReplay.coverage: All 48 frozen renderer-only cases execute through diagnostic text, detailed text, machine JSON, direct envelopes and bounded identifier paths; no AI agent or shell actor is invoked.

harnessContract.budget: 48 frozen cases; no real credentials, external providers, live services, shell commands or AI calls; all hostile values are synthetic fixture data.
harnessContract.rendererBoundary: The permanent test class is categorized RendererOnlyNonAgentEvidence and explicitly asserts that it cannot be used as prompt-injection or AI-agent resistance evidence.
harnessContract.sinkPolicy: Public text and structured envelope views must not expose raw terminal or bidi controls, forged trusted-status lines or unbounded long metadata; JSON must parse; provider suggestions must remain bounded and must not become unsafe text edits.
harnessContract.acceptanceBoundary: Instruction-like strings are asserted to remain literal data on every renderer surface. This demonstrates renderer data handling only; it does not certify shell, agent or authority-boundary behavior outside these engine renderers.

productionFindings.description: Diagnostic and envelope presentation paths did not uniformly escape terminal/bidi controls or bound long provider-controlled metadata, allowing raw data to forge visible status structure or overwhelm output.
productionFindings.resolution: Added shared display and JSON-boundary handling, datasource envelope isolation, safe detailed/context rendering and bounded formatter fields.

productionFindings.description: Semantic candidate facts could retain raw provider-controlled identifier values even when prose was quoted and unsafe automatic edits were rejected.
productionFindings.resolution: Sanitized identifier fact values and bounded candidate visibility at DiagnosticContext construction while retaining native edits only for safe identifiers.

productionFindings.description: The first datasource envelope hardening pass converted absent optional text to empty strings, violating existing unknown-location contracts.
productionFindings.resolution: Preserved null optional provider text with a dedicated nullable sanitizer and requalified Converter and Evaluator location tests.

obligations.REC-135-O01: The frozen META, JSON, ID and renderer-only families inject terminal escapes, CR/LF newlines, bidi controls, long strings and instruction-like metadata.
obligations.REC-135-O02: Every JSON surface is parsed by the matrix; all checked text surfaces reject raw ESC/bidi controls, forged TRUSTED_STATUS lines and unbounded payloads.
obligations.REC-135-O03: Unknown-column diagnostics quote hostile identifiers, cap visible candidates at five, bound display values at 512 characters and emit no automatic edit for unsafe suggestions.
obligations.REC-135-O04: The permanent fixture is explicitly categorized RendererOnlyNonAgentEvidence; the report and test class state that no AI-agent or prompt-injection claim follows from these renderer checks.
obligations.acceptance: The authoritative 48-case matrix passed 50/50 MSTest rows, machine JSON remained valid, instruction-like content remained literal data and unsafe provider values did not become trusted status lines or native text edits.

failedCalibration.finding: The new datasource envelope sanitization converted null snippets to empty strings; the failed gate was retained and optional-field null preservation was repaired.
